Lena (Design): Heads-up: saw a weird flicker when resizing the Console between 900-940px. Primary button inside metric cards slides right when the overflow menu appears. Screenshot in thread. Thoughts on token vs layout fix?
Marco: I can repro on Canary. Looks like horizontal gap + a late media query cause the card width to shrink and push the action group.
Priya (A11y): Two quick accessibility flags: 1) focus lands on the overflow menu sometimes before the CTA after resize, 2) toasts are not consistently announced by VoiceOver.
Lena (Design): My proposal: keep breakpoints but reduce the horizontal gap token at medium widths (space-5 -> space-4) so cards stay wider. Alternate is reserving inline space for actions. Which path is lower risk?
Dan (Frontend): Token swap is lower risk and easy to ship. Reserved space is doable but needs careful truncation handling. CSS snippet for token swap: ```@media (max-width:1000px){ :root{ --card-gap-inline: var(--space-4); } }```
Marco: If we go token-swap, let's only apply it between 720-1000px so larger layouts unchanged.
Priya (A11y): If labels are hidden in any responsive state, add `aria-label` to the buttons and ensure tooltips provide the full label. Also for toasts: use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` and avoid `aria-hidden` on the container.
Lena (Design): Also noticed primary CTA shifts when overflow icon appears. Could we reserve `min-inline-size` on `.card-actions` so CTA position is stable?
Dan (Frontend): Reserve is fine but I'd prefer gradual approach: 1) token-swap prototype, 2) if still jittery, reserve min-inline-size and switch label->icon collapse under 720px. Example CSS for collapse: ```@media (max-width:720px){ .action-btn .label{display:none} }```
Marco: Be careful that collapsing labels doesn't remove keyboard context. Priya?
Priya (A11y): Exactly. When label hidden, set `aria-label` and keep focus order. Also bump focus ring thickness to 2px and use `--color-focus-strong` for contrast.
Dan (Frontend): I'll prototype token-swap + toast offset change. Toast currently uses `top: var(--nav-height)` which clips when nav height increases. I'll change to `top: calc(var(--nav-height) + var(--space-2))`. I'll also ensure toasts only announce once (container has role=status only).
Lena (Design): Nice. Also micro-copy: if tooltip shows shortcut, format as "Export CSV — Shift+E" not parentheses.
review-bot: Design checklist created: https://redwood.internal/tasks/DR-430 — assign when PR is ready. :white_check_mark:
Dan (Frontend): Action items: prototype token-swap (720-1000px), add toast offset + aria-live, ensure aria-labels for collapsed buttons. Will open a small PR today.
Lena (Design): I'll upload mocks for reserved-width vs icon-collapse so we can pick. Priya will test with screen reader.
Priya (A11y): Will run VoiceOver/JAWS checks on the prototype and report if toasts double-announce.
Marco: Sounds good. Ping if you want me to test truncation with long labels.
Lena (Design): Thanks everyone — aiming for next sprint. If you spot other edge cases, drop them here.
